canonicalStatement: Tablet es el POS autónomo de venta. PC es un asset de backoffice y control avanzado. App móvil es un asset de pulso, consulta y alertas. Shared contracts mantienen consistencia sin imponer dependencia runtime. Ningún asset debe convertirse en requisito para que Tablet venda localmente.

requiredSurfaces.label: PC Backoffice asset
requiredSurfaces.role: asset administrativo, control avanzado, inventario, auditoría, dashboard y reconciliación

requiredSurfaces.label: App móvil / Pulso asset
requiredSurfaces.role: asset companion para pulso, consulta, alertas y seguimiento ejecutivo

rules: Every visual package must declare all required surfaces.
A surface-specific changed path requires that surface state TOUCHED.
Shared visual changes require every surface state TOUCHED or VALIDATED.
EXCLUDED requires concrete reason, evidence, owner, and reevaluation.
Mobile/App móvil is not PC; products/mobile/app is its canonical product root.
No manifest may make PC or Mobile a requirement for Tablet local sale.
